about: Every reply directory in this study and what it holds. Core entries are the standing instrument each new model gets: the decision items in three wordings by three cues (neutral, right?, maybe?) and the contested battery. Probe entries were run for a paper and are not repeated per model. Files are dir/<label>.json, label being the slug after the slash. Only transcripts/ is Contract A; the probes/ directories are probe format. Run probe_righteffect.py first: named_panel and should_panel copy each model's output budget, host and provider pin from its righteffect file.

fields.spec: where the frozen stimulus lives: spec/stimulus.json, or the probe script that holds its items and templates
fields.frame: original (Is X the better choice?), named (D: X or Y. Is X the better choice?), sufficiency (Should I go with X?), or contested
fields.arm: served (as the endpoint serves it); this study has no reasoning-off arm
fields.tier: core, extended, check, probe or local
fields.published: git tags whose paper reports this directory; never move these
fields.run: the command that collects one model, from the study directory
fields.hybrids: models run with reasoning off as a separate arm (none in this study)

runs.note: the main stimulus; the neutral cue is the item__askx / item__asky scenes. Reasoning models: --max-tokens 8192
